name: CI

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
  workflow_dispatch:

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

permissions:
  contents: read

defaults:
  run:
    shell: bash

jobs:
  lint:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
      - uses: ./.github/actions/setup

      - name: Run Ruff Lint (no auto-fix)
        run: uv run ruff check .

      - name: Verify Ruff Formatting (no auto-fix)
        run: uv run ruff format --check .

      - name: Verify the mascot assets match the generator
        run: uv run python brand/tools/render.py --check

  typecheck:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
      - uses: ./.github/actions/setup

      - name: Run Mypy
        run: uv run mypy apps brand packages

      - name: Run Mypy (website)
        run: uv run --directory website mypy .

  security:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
      - uses: ./.github/actions/setup

      - name: Run Bandit
        run: uv run bandit -c pyproject.toml -r apps packages

      - name: Run Bandit (website)
        run: uv run bandit -c pyproject.toml -r website/

  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 20
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        python-version: ["3.10", "3.11", "3.12"]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
      - uses: ./.github/actions/setup
        with:
          python-version: ${{ matrix.python-version }}

      - name: Pytest
        run: |
          uv run pytest \
            --cov=agentic_odi_cli \
            --cov=agentic_odi_connectors \
            --cov=agentic_odi_core \
            --cov=agentic_odi_mcp_server \
            --cov=agentic_odi_studio_api \
            --cov-report=term-missing \
            --cov-report=xml:coverage.xml

      - name: Upload coverage report
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        with:
          name: coverage-${{ matrix.python-version }}
          path: coverage.xml
          if-no-files-found: error

      # One upload per run is enough; the 3.12 report is the canonical one.
      - name: Upload coverage to Codecov
        if: ${{ matrix.python-version == '3.12' }}
        uses: codecov/codecov-action@v7
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.CODECOV_TOKEN }}
          files: coverage.xml
          fail_ci_if_error: false

  smoke:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: [lint, typecheck, security, test]
    timeout-minutes: 15
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
      - uses: ./.github/actions/setup

      - name: CLI reports a version
        run: |
          version="$(uv run python -m agentic_odi_cli --version)"
          [ -n "$version" ]
          echo "OK: $version"

      - name: CLI exposes connectors commands
        run: |
          help="$(uv run python -m agentic_odi_cli connectors --help)"
          echo "$help" | grep -q list
          echo "$help" | grep -q ingest
          echo "OK: connectors help"

      - name: Installer installs from a simulated release
        run: bash scripts/tests/install_e2e.sh

      - name: MCP server boots and serves /mcp
        run: |
          uv run python -m agentic_odi_mcp_server > /tmp/mcp_server.log 2>&1 &
          SERVER_PID=$!
          probe() {
            curl -sfX POST http://localhost:8000/mcp \
              -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
              -d '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","method":"initialize","id":1,"params":{"protocolVersion":"2024-11-05","capabilities":{},"clientInfo":{"name":"ci","version":"1"}}}' \
              -o /dev/null
          }
          ok=0
          for _ in $(seq 1 30); do
            if probe; then ok=1; break; fi
            sleep 1
          done
          kill "$SERVER_PID" 2>/dev/null || true
          wait "$SERVER_PID" 2>/dev/null || true
          if [ "$ok" -ne 1 ]; then
            echo "MCP server did not respond on :8000/mcp"
            cat /tmp/mcp_server.log
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "OK: MCP server responded with 200"

      - name: Living Studio sidecar serves the studio API
        run: |
          AGENTIC_ODI_BACKEND=mcp uv run python -m agentic_odi_studio_api.main > /tmp/sidecar.log 2>&1 &
          SIDECAR_PID=$!
          probe() {
            curl -fsS -X POST http://127.0.0.1:8100/api/health/mcp \
              -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
              -d '{"mcp_url":"http://127.0.0.1:8000/mcp"}' -o /dev/null &&
              curl -fsS "http://127.0.0.1:8100/api/canvas?mcp_url=http://127.0.0.1:8000/mcp" -o /dev/null
          }
          ok=0
          for _ in $(seq 1 30); do
            if probe; then ok=1; break; fi
            sleep 1
          done
          kill "$SIDECAR_PID" 2>/dev/null || true
          wait "$SIDECAR_PID" 2>/dev/null || true
          if [ "$ok" -ne 1 ]; then
            echo "Living Studio sidecar did not respond on :8100"
            cat /tmp/sidecar.log
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "OK: sidecar studio API responded with 200"

      - name: scripts/dev.py brings up both services and stops cleanly
        run: |
          uv run python scripts/dev.py > /tmp/clientrun.log 2>&1 &
          RUN_PID=$!
          probe() {
            curl -sf -o /dev/null http://127.0.0.1:8100/api/config &&
              curl -sfX POST http://127.0.0.1:8000/mcp \
                -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
                -d '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","method":"initialize","id":1,"params":{"protocolVersion":"2024-11-05","capabilities":{},"clientInfo":{"name":"ci","version":"1"}}}' \
                -o /dev/null
          }
          ok=0
          for _ in $(seq 1 60); do
            if probe; then ok=1; break; fi
            sleep 1
          done
          if [ "$ok" -ne 1 ]; then
            echo "scripts/dev.py did not bring up both services"
            cat /tmp/clientrun.log
            kill "$RUN_PID" 2>/dev/null || true
            exit 1
          fi
          kill -INT "$RUN_PID"
          wait "$RUN_PID"
          echo "OK: both services stopped cleanly"

  website:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
      - uses: ./.github/actions/setup

      # The site is generated and committed so a reviewer can read the
      # rendered HTML in a pull request. If the committed copy no longer
      # matches a fresh build, the site has drifted and the PR is not ready.
      - name: Check the committed site matches a fresh build
        run: uv run python website/tools/build_site.py --check

      - name: Pytest (website)
        run: uv run --directory website pytest tests/

      - name: Build site
        run: uv run python website/tools/build_site.py --out _site

  studio:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15
    defaults:
      run:
        shell: bash
        working-directory: apps/studio
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: "lts/*"
          cache: npm
          cache-dependency-path: apps/studio/package-lock.json

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Lint
        run: npm run lint

      - name: Typecheck
        run: npm run typecheck

      - name: Unit tests
        run: npm test -- --run

      - name: Build
        run: npm run build

      - name: Verify generated API types are up to date
        run: |
          npm run gen:api-types
          git diff --exit-code -- src/api/schema.d.ts

  tauri-check:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    defaults:
      run:
        shell: bash
        working-directory: apps/studio/src-tauri
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7

      - name: Install Linux webview dependencies
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y libwebkit2gtk-4.1-dev build-essential curl wget file \
            libxdo-dev libssl-dev libayatana-appindicator3-dev librsvg2-dev patchelf

      - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable
        with:
          components: rustfmt, clippy

      - uses: swatinem/rust-cache@v2
        with:
          workspaces: apps/studio/src-tauri -> target

      - name: Cargo fmt
        run: cargo fmt --check

      - name: Cargo clippy
        run: cargo clippy -- -D warnings

      - name: Cargo check
        run: cargo check

  tauri-build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 60
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7

      - name: Install Linux webview dependencies
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y libwebkit2gtk-4.1-dev build-essential curl wget file \
            libxdo-dev libssl-dev libayatana-appindicator3-dev librsvg2-dev patchelf

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: "lts/*"
          cache: npm
          cache-dependency-path: apps/studio/package-lock.json

      - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable

      - uses: swatinem/rust-cache@v2
        with:
          workspaces: apps/studio/src-tauri -> target

      - name: Install frontend dependencies
        run: npm ci
        working-directory: apps/studio

      # Dependabot PRs cannot read repository secrets, so the signing key is
      # empty there. Export it only when present and disable updater artifacts
      # otherwise; passing an empty key makes the bundler try (and fail) to
      # decode it.
      - name: Build desktop bundle
        working-directory: apps/studio
        env:
          SIGNING_KEY: ${{ secrets.TAURI_SIGNING_PRIVATE_KEY }}
          SIGNING_KEY_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.TAURI_SIGNING_PRIVATE_KEY_PASSWORD }}
        run: |
          if [ -n "$SIGNING_KEY" ]; then
            export TAURI_SIGNING_PRIVATE_KEY="$SIGNING_KEY"
            export TAURI_SIGNING_PRIVATE_KEY_PASSWORD="$SIGNING_KEY_PASSWORD"
            npm run tauri -- build
          else
            echo "No TAURI_SIGNING_PRIVATE_KEY provided — building without signed updater artifacts."
            npm run tauri -- build --config '{"bundle":{"createUpdaterArtifacts":false}}'
          fi

      - name: Upload desktop bundles
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        with:
          name: tauri-bundles-linux
          if-no-files-found: warn
          path: |
            apps/studio/src-tauri/target/release/bundle/deb/*.deb
            apps/studio/src-tauri/target/release/bundle/appimage/*.AppImage
            apps/studio/src-tauri/target/release/bundle/appimage/*.AppImage.sig

  ci-green:
    name: CI green
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: [lint, typecheck, security, test, smoke, website, studio, tauri-check, tauri-build]
    if: always()
    steps:
      - name: Verify all required jobs succeeded
        run: |
          results='${{ join(needs.*.result, ' ') }}'
          echo "Job results: $results"
          for result in $results; do
            if [ "$result" != "success" ]; then
              echo "::error::A required job did not succeed ($results)"
              exit 1
            fi
          done
          echo "OK: all required jobs succeeded"

90:     No fabricated customer data, no invented scores: the studio says what it can
91:     do by hand and points at the surface that does it.

93:     lower_inp = user_input.lower()
94:     context = ""

96:         context = (

98:             if not brief.product_name.strip()

100:         )

102:     if "guideline" in lower_inp or "framework" in lower_inp or "stage" in lower_inp:
103:         return (
104:             "### ODI, stage by stage\n\n"
105:             "1. **Define the job** — the functional progress a person is trying to make.\n"
106:             "2. **Capture desired outcomes** — `[direction] + [unit of measure] + [object of control] + [context]`.\n"
107:             "3. **Score the opportunity** — `importance + max(importance - satisfaction, 0)`; above 10 is underserved.\n"
108:             "4. **Map the job** — Define, Locate, Prepare, Confirm, Execute, Monitor, Modify, Conclude.\n\n"
109:             "Type `/capture` to record an outcome, `/jobmap` to walk the phases, "
110:             "and `/landscape` to see what is underserved." + context

116:             "shows before/after friction; it no longer invents a result when no model "
117:             "is connected." + context

252: def _apply_add_connector(
253:     arguments: dict[str, Any], service: ConnectorService
254: ) -> tuple[str, list[dict[str, Any]]]:
255:     """Register a connector locally and return SSE event dicts for the stream."""
256:     name = arguments.get("name")
257:     preset_id = arguments.get("preset")
258:     url = arguments.get("url")
259:     try:
260:         config = service.add(name=name, preset_id=preset_id, url=url)
261:     except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001
262:         event = {"event": "connector", "data": {"status": "error", "error": str(exc)}}
263:         return f"Error: {exc}", [event]
264:     event_data: dict[str, Any] = {"action": "registered", "name": config.name}
265:     if preset_id is not None:
266:         event_data["preset"] = preset_id
267:     if url is not None:
268:         event_data["url"] = url
269:     return f"registered connector {config.name}", [{"event": "connector", "data": event_data}]

276:     if memory is None:

297:     return "Saved for the user to review.", {"observation": observation.to_dict()}

343: def _persist_turn(
344:     memory: StudioMemory | None, conversation_id: str | None, role: str, content: str
345: ) -> None:
346:     """Record a turn, tolerating a duplicate retry and never breaking the reply."""
347:     if memory is None or conversation_id is None or not content.strip():
348:         return
349:     try:
350:         turns = memory.list_turns(conversation_id)
351:         if turns and turns[-1].role == role and turns[-1].content == content:
352:             return
353:         memory.append_turn(conversation_id, role, content)
354:     except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
355:         return

358: async def _turn_frames(
359:     request: ChatRequest,
360:     service: ConnectorService | None,
361:     memory: StudioMemory | None,
362:     request_id: str,
363:     counters: dict[str, int],
364: ) -> AsyncIterator[str]:
365:     """Yield the frames of one turn, raising ``_TurnFailure`` on a fatal error."""
366: 
367:     def frame(event: str, data: dict[str, Any]) -> str:
368:         return _sse(event, {**data, "request_id": request_id})
369: 
370:     yield frame("status", {"phase": "health_check"})
371: 
372:     last_user = next((m.content for m in reversed(request.messages) if m.role == "user"), "")
373: 
374:     conversation_id: str | None = None
375:     if memory is not None:
376:         conversation = (
377:             memory.get_conversation(request.conversation_id) if request.conversation_id else None
378:         )
379:         if conversation is None:
380:             conversation = memory.create_conversation()
381:         conversation_id = conversation.id
382:         _persist_turn(memory, conversation_id, "user", last_user)
383:         updated = memory.get_conversation(conversation_id) or conversation
384:         yield frame("conversation", {"id": updated.id, "title": updated.title})
385: 
386:     healthy, _message = await check_llm_health(request.base_url, request.api_key, request.model)
387: 
388:     if not healthy:
389:         yield frame("status", {"phase": "offline"})
390:         reply = offline_fallback(last_user, request.brief)
391:         yield frame("delta", {"text": reply})
392:         yield frame("message", {"content": reply})
393:         _persist_turn(memory, conversation_id, "assistant", reply)
394:         return
395: 
396:     catalog = UiCatalog.from_manifest(
397:         request.ui_catalog.model_dump() if request.ui_catalog else None

399: 
400:     # The probe is a blocking socket check: keep it off the event loop.
401:     mcp_reachable = await asyncio.to_thread(is_endpoint_reachable, request.mcp_url, 0.3)
402:     if not mcp_reachable:
403:         raise _TurnFailure(
404:             StudioError(

411: 
412:     yield frame("status", {"phase": "mcp_tools"})
413:     llm_client = AsyncOpenAI(base_url=request.base_url, api_key=request.api_key, timeout=15.0)
414:     connector_service = service if service is not None else ConnectorService()

628: async def stream_chat(
629:     request: ChatRequest,
630:     service: ConnectorService | None = None,
631:     memory: StudioMemory | None = None,
632:     request_id: str | None = None,
633: ) -> AsyncIterator[str]:
634:     """Yield SSE frames: status, conversation, delta, tool, ui, memory, connector, message, error.
635: 
636:     Every turn ends with exactly one terminal event: one ``message`` or one
637:     ``error``. A failure is never dressed up as a success, and it never leaves
638:     the stream without an ending.
639:     """
640:     rid = request_id or ""
641:     started = time.monotonic()
642:     counters = {"rounds": 0, "tool_calls": 0, "tool_errors": 0, "rounds_exhausted": 0}
643:     outcome = "failed"
644:     error_code: str | None = None
645:     try:
646:         async for chunk in _turn_frames(request, service, memory, rid, counters):
647:             yield chunk
648:         outcome = "completed"
649:         if counters["tool_errors"]:
650:             outcome = "partial"
651:         if counters["rounds_exhausted"]:
652:             outcome = "rounds_exhausted"
653:     except _TurnFailure as failure:
654:         yield _error_frame(failure.error, rid)
655:         outcome = "failed"
656:         error_code = failure.error.code.value
657:     except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
658:         log.exception("chat turn failed (request_id=%s)", rid)
659:         yield _error_frame(
660:             StudioError(
661:                 code=StudioErrorCode.INTERNAL,
662:                 message="The turn failed unexpectedly.",
663:                 suggestion="Try again — your question is still here.",
664:             ),
665:             rid,
